_provenance.note: Every offer in this file is DEMO/SEED data (is_demo: true), not a real supplier's actual pricing or capacity. Real supplier pricing is difficult to scrape reliably (complex, non-public business logic - see the first customer-discovery interview), so this MVP does not attempt to. This file exists to validate the OFFER concept and the 'Best Price' / 'Fastest' recommendation perspectives with real users before investing in real supplier-provided or manually-verified offer data. No demo offer may be marked verified - see Offer's model validator.
